provenance: NASA/JPL planetary masses (DE440) and astrodynamic parameters; manually transcribed reference constants, not downloaded ephemeris vectors
notes: GM alone cannot produce any local acceleration or tide without instantaneous Earth-relative position vector and frame; actual Horizons ephemerides not yet ingested.
Planet and planetary-system barycenter units/scopes differ by object. NASA/JPL DE440 and object identifiers must match ephemeris convention.
Earth's own GM belongs to local baseline, not additional external Earth-source tidal perturbation on itself.
A 51-year recurrence hypothesis has no established observational signal or physical period in this catalog.
